chunks: And from him, from several of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Qasim ibn Yahya, from his grandfather al-Hasan ibn Rashid, from Abu Basir, who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'Tahnik your children with dates, for thus the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) did with al-Hasan and al-Husayn (peace be upon them).'
ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic practice of Tahnik and how did the Prophet perform it with his grandsons?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the Sunnah of Tahnik, where a chewed date is applied to the newborn's palate to introduce sweetness and signify the beginning of life with the Prophet's example. It specifically highlights the honor bestowed upon Imam al-Hasan and Imam al-Husayn (AS) by linking their initiation to the Prophet Muhammad (SAW), reinforcing the continuity of prophetic tradition within the Ahl al-Bayt. This practice serves as both a spiritual blessing and a practical method for introducing the child to the taste of the Quran and Sunnah.
